plan.title: What changed
items: Your note after watching all six sequences (28 Oct): the doorstep is too long, the consciousness bit is already done in Maddie's intro, and they shouldn't resist.
So the doorstep tab now has three short drafts, 2I, 2J and 2K, all in your shape: Maddie offers a way to fix it together, the old lady asks "How's that?", Maddie gives the time machine, done.
"Now" shows 2H, what's in gpom-3-B-door-r3 today (about 104 s of picture).

plan.title: How they differ
items: 2I, about 25 s: your words nearly verbatim; she goes in to talk to the others.
2J, about 33 s: keeps "Your boss killed everyone we ever loved", says once that it runs on them (scene D leans on that), Derek's "I'm in".
2K, about 32 s: "Same as you, I reckon"; Sandra's "Amen" and the crowd answer reuse the takes we already have.

items: Pick one draft (note any line). Picking starts the recut: new voices, scene B recut, gpom-3-B-door-r4, and the timeline page updated in the same round.
